model_note: The recipe behind Halomark's model: Kev, fine-tuned on 2,000 founders, reading the answers to TRL's 40 questions. These are its scores on 600 test founders it never learned from or was tuned on, for the yes/no question ($500M or more). Halomark's own version, trained the same way, also predicts the outcome band and timing.
source: results/summary/d1-final (C3, test) on the research branch
